description:
Close a support ticket

Closes one of your support tickets for good once the issue is solved. Use it only when nothing is left to do: a closed ticket takes no more replies and cannot be reopened, so a follow up needs a new ticket from `create_ticket`. To add information instead, use `reply_to_ticket`. Every call sends the closing email to your account address again, so call it once. `ticketId` comes from `list_tickets`, which afterwards shows the ticket only with `includeArchived=true`. 404 when the ticket is not yours.
name: close_ticket
title: Close a support ticket
